content: आम्लः, -म्ला The tamarind tree. .{@-म्लम्@} Sourness, acidity. .{@-पञ्चकम्@} The aggregate of the five following Ziziphus Jujuba (<lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>बोर</ns>), Pomegranate (<lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>डाळिंब</ns>), Mangosteen (<lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>कोकंब</ns>), Tamarind (<lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>चिंच</ns>), Averrhoa Carambola (<lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>करमर</ns>). .{@-वेतसः@} <ab>N.</ab> of the plant Rumex Vesicarius (<lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>चुका</ns>).
